shared_prompts.photo: Use case: photorealistic-natural. One real photograph for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English. Natural everyday photographic detail, real material texture and correct perspective; NOT an illustration, 3D render, collage, cutout or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, blur bands, vignette, watermark or captions. No letters, words, numbers, logos or brand marks anywhere, not on signs, screens, clothes, bags, machines or vehicles. A first-time learner must understand the picture instantly on a small phone screen. Every visible hand has five natural fingers. Do not imitate earlier course photos.
shared_prompts.solo: Only this one person is in the photo; there is nobody else, even far in the background.
shared_prompts.daytime: It is clearly daytime with soft natural light.
shared_prompts.near_far_scene: The meaning of the photo is NEAR versus FAR. Exactly two things of the same kind are in the photo, and they differ only in color. The near one is with the person in the left part of the photo, large and sharp. The far one stands alone in the right third of the photo, clearly farther away, against a plain wall with nothing else around it; it is in focus and easy to recognize even on a small phone screen, and its center is about three quarters of the way across the photo, well clear of the right edge. The camera is at chest height and sees the whole scene from the side, so that the space between the person and the far thing runs from left to right across the photo: an arm pointed at the far thing would be seen side-on as a long line across the photo, never pointing toward the camera. The floor and wall between them are plain and empty. There is no mirror, no picture on the wall, no shelf of objects, and no third thing of that kind anywhere.
